divergences.preSync: The local opt-in panic hook did not install an allocation-error hook, so allocation failures had no structured native report.
divergences.postSync: When GJC_NATIVE_CRASH_DIAGNOSTICS is enabled, allocation failures emit the canonical stderr line and a structured size/alignment/backtrace report under ~/.gjc/logs.
divergences.reason: Adopted the pinned upstream alloc-error-hook recording while preserving D8's opt-in gate and GJC path.
